subject: afi
title: (R)AFI.------C.INFO.
description: Chart 1 of 2 on book p. 45 (BK(NM)-21). AFI (affinity insight) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; C-INFO (composite information) is the partner. From the subject: AF-DY (affinity dynamics) and EXT-DYM (extended dynamics). From EXT-DYM: BIA (bi-aitional). From BIA: COS-P (cosmic particulars) and ALT-F (alternative functionalism). From COS-P: PHY-U-P (physical universe particular) and INFO-PROJ (information projection). From INFO-PROJ: INFO-ALGN (information alignment).
